targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT (count(*) FILTER (WHERE status='success') * 100.0 / NULLIF(count(*),0))::numeric(5,1) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type IN ('scenario.completed','scenario.failed') AND $__timeFilter(received_at);
SELECT count(DISTINCT payload->'scenario'->>'user_email') AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT avg((payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int)::numeric(10,1) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT (percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total')::int) / 1000.0)::numeric(10,1) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='llm.inference.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT $__timeGroup(received_at, '1h') AS time, type AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type LIKE 'scenario.%' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT (payload->'scenario'->>'origin') || ' → ' || (payload->'scenario'->>'destination') AS route, count(*) AS searches FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'destination' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 2 DESC LIMIT 15;

SELECT received_at AS "Время", payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' AS "Email", data AS "Запрос", (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int AS "Билетов", ((payload->'scenario'->'timings_ms'->>'total')::int / 1000.0)::numeric(10,1) AS "Sec", status AS "Статус", payload->'scenario'->>'aviasales_url' AS "URL" FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 100;

SELECT round(100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE type='scenario.failed' OR (type='scenario.completed' AND (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int = 0)) / NULLIF(count(*),0), 2) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type IN ('scenario.completed','scenario.failed') AND $__timeFilter(received_at);
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.failed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int = 0 AND payload->'scenario'->>'early_return_reason' IS NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);
SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.completed' AND payload->'scenario'->>'early_return_reason' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(received_at);

SELECT $__timeGroup(received_at, '1h') AS time, CASE WHEN type='scenario.failed' THEN 'provider_failed' WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'early_return_reason' IS NOT NULL THEN 'early_return' WHEN (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int = 0 THEN 'rec_engine_filtered_empty' END AS metric, count(*) AS value FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND (type='scenario.failed' OR (type='scenario.completed' AND (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int = 0)) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1;

SELECT received_at AS "Время", payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' AS "Email", data AS "Запрос", CASE WHEN type='scenario.failed' THEN COALESCE('provider_failed: ' || (payload->'scenario'->>'error_type'), 'provider_failed') WHEN payload->'scenario'->>'early_return_reason' IS NOT NULL THEN 'early_return: ' || (payload->'scenario'->>'early_return_reason') ELSE 'rec_engine_filtered_empty' END AS "Причина" FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND (type='scenario.failed' OR (type='scenario.completed' AND (payload->'scenario'->>'tickets_shown')::int = 0)) AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 50;

SELECT received_at AS "Время", payload->'scenario'->>'user_email' AS "Email", data AS "Запрос", payload->'scenario'->>'error_type' AS "Тип ошибки", payload->'scenario'->>'error_message' AS "Сообщение" FROM events WHERE service='avia_system' AND type='scenario.failed' AND $__timeFilter(received_at) ORDER BY received_at DESC LIMIT 50;
